updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: A security feature bypass vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows an authorized attacker to bypass certificate validation controls over the network. Admins managing certificate infrastructure should apply patches immediately to prevent unauthorized certificate issuance or spoofing attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-118148: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services has been updated with corrected information and CVSS scoring. Identity administrators should review this vulnerability and patch accordingly to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation within their directory.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109467: Azure DevOps Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication flaw in Azure DevOps Server permits an authorized attacker to execute arbitrary code remotely. Organizations using Azure DevOps for source control and CI/CD should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized code execution and potential supply-chain attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62903: Microsoft.Data.SqlClient Information Disclosure via Authentication Bypass
updates.summary: A capture-replay authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft.Data.SqlClient allows unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information from SQL Server over the network. Applications and services using this library should update immediately to prevent credential compromise and data leakage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Administrators can now apply Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels directly to Entra cloud security groups, automatically inheriting the same label policies used for Microsoft 365 groups and sites. This extends data classification governance to identity objects without requiring separate label configuration, improving compliance consistency.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope Lifecycle State Evaluation Control
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes now offer explicit controls for evaluating recipient and site owner lifecycle states in scope membership rules. This enhancement helps admins ensure retention policies and DLP rules remain correctly targeted as users and resources transition through their organizational lifecycle.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Protection for Local AI Agents
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now expands inline protection to local AI agents, allowing admins to enforce policies on prompts, files, and tool interactions to prevent sensitive data exposure through agent-to-human and agent-to-tool workflows. This addresses security risks as enterprises integrate AI agents with identity and data systems.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Integration with Azure Firewall for Network Layer Protection
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview extends DLP enforcement to the network layer through Azure Firewall integration, enabling detection and protection of sensitive data in network traffic from servers, VMs, and automated workloads. This allows admins to block unauthorized cloud application access and API calls while monitoring AI-generated traffic.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP and Information Protection auto-labeling capabilities now extend to non-Microsoft SaaS platforms including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. This broader coverage helps admins enforce consistent data protection policies across hybrid cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Alert Classification
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management now enables analysts with appropriate permissions to classify alerts as True Positive, Benign (operational), or False Positive with predefined reasons. This replaces the previous dismissal workflow and helps admins better tune policies and generate more accurate risk reporting.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Inheritance for Teams Meeting Artifacts
updates.summary: Teams meeting recordings, transcripts, and Loop notes can now automatically inherit the sensitivity label from the meeting itself, eliminating manual labeling overhead. This ensures consistent protection across collaboration artifacts and reduces the risk of unprotected meeting-generated content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Improved Sensitive Information Types
updates.summary: Microsoft has enhanced its out-of-the-box sensitive information types (SITs) to more accurately and reliably identify sensitive data patterns. Admins benefit from improved precision in DLP rule matching and auto-labeling, reducing false positives and false negatives in content classification.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Recurring Classifier Refresh
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview's on-demand classification capability will evolve to support recurring refresh schedules, allowing administrators to automatically re-evaluate existing content as business context and data sensitivity change over time. This helps maintain current classification accuracy without manual intervention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Monitoring for FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP now monitors and enforces policies on sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols. Admins can configure transfer activities and apply restrictive actions to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration through legacy file transfer protocols.
